hemisphere_relation: atlas reconstruction; not an independently measured functional specimen
relationship_note: Functional estimates and reused literature parcellations are atlas overlays, not additional animals or primary observed field boundaries. Figure 13C reuses Felleman & Van Essen (1991), already represented in this project.
scale_note: No uniform biological area calibration: flattening has spatially varying areal distortion. Published scale/grid is not a substitute for the per-tile 3-D metric.

unmeasured.label: V1 inner estimate
unmeasured.reason: PDF pp. 5–7 (printed 7083–7085), figure 4 and Table 1 explicitly distinguish nonuniform flatmap tile areas from 3-D cortical surface areas. A single grid or scale bar cannot recover a field surface area. The PDF does not provide the corresponding mesh tiles/areal Jacobian. Functional borders are composite estimates from other subjects. No new biological field area or cortical percentage is assigned from these raster pixels.
